t_advice_summary_textbox.text: Use brown and yellow if I can to get the maximum points. It will swap around at some point and try to track which are slowly degrading of score so you can swap them out for the opposite colours that appear.

vb_textbox.text: I think it is very random. Stick to what you feel comfortable with. If a certain gnome yields good score try that gnome again until the score doesn't seem well. Play it to your own comfort. I liked the brown hat gnome a lot, the rest did feel random for me. Try to not miss any the most. Have fun!
